messages:
mika: FYI mkdocs linkcheck is failing for a couple pages. Seems like headings with trailing spaces turn into wrong anchors. Example: '## Usage ' ended up as #usage%20 in the TOC and linkcheck flags it. anyone seen this?

ben: can you paste the linkcheck output?

mika: here's the relevant snippet from CI:
```
LinkCheckError: Page /guides/setup/#usage → 404
  href: /guides/setup/#usage 
  but file contains id 'usage '
```

jordan: yup trailing whitespace in headings. mkdocs slugify trims but mkdocs-material slugify differs. Quick fix: run a regex to trim headings in docs before build:
```
perl -0777 -pe "s/^(#+\s+.*)\s+$/\1/gm" -i **/*.md
```
I'll add a git pre-commit hook snippet if folks want.

sara: also check for hidden chars (U+00A0 or ZWJ) — they look like spaces but break slug. `git grep -nP "[\x{00A0}\x{200D}]"` helps. 

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck/guides - failed — see https://ci.redwood-inference/example/1234 :warning:

ben: ok can we do a small PR to canonicalize heading whitespace + run linkcheck in CI? add test that ensures heading 'Usage' normalizes to #usage 

mika: opening PR now. small script + regen of affected files. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678

jordan: i'll review. also suggest adding `markdown_extensions = ['pymdownx.slugs']` fallback or normalize step in docs build. otherwise we keep bumping into locale/slug differences. 

sara: we should update docs contributing guide to mention 'no trailing whitespace in headings' and include the sed/perl snippet. I'll add a one-liner to the guide.

mika: PR linked and CI rerun. @ci-bot please re-run linkcheck when PR merged.

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild for PR #678 — linkcheck run queued :gear:

ben: once CI green, I'll merge. thanks all :tada:

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck/guides - passed (after fixes) — https://ci.redwood-inference/example/1234 :white_check_mark:
